summary: Bind the curated Planner doctor directly in the root command graph so runtime and static command resolution agree.
reason: The runtime registration hook replaced generated newDoctorCmd with newPlannerDoctorCmd after root construction, while verify-skill resolves rootCmd.AddCommand edges in filesystem order. A CI traversal could therefore select the generic doctor constructor and miss the documented --live flag.
validated_outcome: The curated doctor is registered directly by newRootCmd, the public binary help names keyword-planner-pp-cli, and scoped CLI tests plus official verify-skill pass under normal and reverse source traversal.
